flags.description: High stated satisfaction despite prolonged stagnation (>=7 years without promotion in >=10 year tenure).
flags.hr_recommendation: Conduct exploratory 1-on-1 check-in; do not assume retention based solely on survey score.

flags.description: Low job satisfaction reported immediately following a recent promotion or manager change (<=1 year).
flags.hr_recommendation: Review role adjustment and onboarding support; dissatisfaction may reflect temporary transition stress.

flags.description: Identical rating submitted across all satisfaction and involvement questions (potential survey fatigue).
flags.hr_recommendation: Flag for qualitative verification. Use multi-signal HR metrics rather than survey scores alone.

survey_bias.scientific_disclaimer: Data quality flags identify divergence between self-reported survey indicators and administrative records. They reflect survey response patterns or role transition effects, NOT evidence of employee dishonesty. Because historical benchmark data is cross-sectional (single-observation per employee), temporal response consistency cannot be tested without longitudinal survey panels.
